naming.class_type: derived type <name>_t in kwx_types.f90, e.g. wxframe_t (FortranClassName / BuildFortranTypeIdentifiers)
naming.constant: raw interface function in module kwxffi, e.g. wxID_ANY() (FortranName / BuildConstantNames)
naming.constructor: module function in the class module, e.g. wx_frame_create(...) result(result_object) (FortranMethodIdentifier)
naming.method: module subroutine/function in the class module, e.g. wx_frame_set_title(self, text) (FortranMethodIdentifier)
naming.module: one Fortran module per class, e.g. module wx_frame in wx_frame.f90 (FortranClassModuleName)

events.handler_type: event_callback (abstract interface subroutine event_callback(fun, data, evt) bind(C) in wx_events.f90, handed to wx_evt_handler_bind as a wxclosure_t)
